title: 38岁两次退出后，他说创业是致富唯一途径
title_en: At 38, After Two Exits, He Says Entrepreneurship Is the Only Path to Wealth
title_jp: 38歳、2回のエグジット後、起業こそ富への唯一の道と語る
title_ar: في الـ38، بعد تخارجين، يقول إن ريادة الأعمال هي الطريق الوحيد للثراء

{"ops": [{"insert": "38岁两次退出后，他说创业是致富唯一途径"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "拿66万美元pre-seed，他搬到硅谷重新开始", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Snow Lee在韩国时exit了两家business。上个月，举家搬到California，做最新项目PlugBear。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Business银行里还有47万美元，收到angel investors现金注入后。目前月入7200美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "直到大学毕业开始第一家公司那一刻，Snow才第一次think about money。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Growing up，家庭不struggling。不rich，但table上有food，所以didn't need think about it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但现在，wants be rich。开始dream about future，realized needed money even focus on that dream。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Although don't think money is most important thing in world，believe it is mandatory element of getting to next level of Maslow's hierarchy of needs。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Individuals resources太restricted。Need money让money work for you。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "According to Snow，"}, {"insert": "最高效uplevel resources的方式是building business。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""相信running business是become rich from scratch的唯一途径。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Since that first startup 15 years ago，Snow和cofounder Liam做了很多项目——university students匿名论坛、gamified weight loss app、mobile lock screen service等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Two startups grew到被acquire的程度，undisclosed amounts。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在再做一次，但这次在美国——San Francisco。Pricey，但that's where it's all happening，对吧？上个月，moved families、settled down in Bay Area。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "PlugBear", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "是SaaS产品，帮客户integrate custom GPTs进daily tools如Slack、HubSpot、Teams等，十分钟内，无需coding。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "虽然不是first startup，但是first time ever charged customers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Until now，所有产品通过ads monetize。这次用subscription model。尽可能早收费。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "今年早些时候看到first-ever paid customer时，through the roof。但也extremely anxious。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "First time charging，wasn't sure providing enough value。Didn't know if customer would be satisfied month later。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But worked。Ultimately，think fear was good thing。Resulted in reaching out to customers better support them。Plus，showed how much he cares。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "财务状况："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "PlugBear收入：7300美元/月", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "融资：66万美元pre-seed", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "创始人薪资：10万美元/年（韩国时5万）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业账户：47万美元", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "个人账户：5位数", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Funding doesn't mean found product-market fit。Also doesn't guarantee success。Although really happy see number in bank account，understood just the beginning、got back to work。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "PlugBear收到66万美元funding。说这route不是for everyone——depends on strategy和business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Build previous businesses时，Snow built network。是那个network——相信他的人们——connected him with current angel investors。They knew what he was up to because he was "}, {"insert": "building in public。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If looking for investor，those是key elements——building和leveraging network，building in public。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Even able get investment prior to clearly defined product——they invested in him和team，not necessarily product itself。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""相信money是credit。是trust。If have enough credit make people trust in value provide，can earn money from it。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "So far，花了19万of 66万。Used speed up validation process、get to market faster。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""As startup founders，need resources validate hypotheses。Funding是最critical resources之一。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launched 5+ products、tested by delivering landing page prototypes to audiences via paid marketing。每个产品花1000-2000美元广告。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Once PlugBear validated，expanded team build product——and value for customers——faster。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eventually raise more money，but not yet。Want wait further fundraising until business more predictable、better understanding of customer acquisition costs。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "八、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "月商业支出："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "7人团队工资：2.5万", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "租金（Wework）：600", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "托管：700", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "软件：300", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "广告和营销：500-1000", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "个人支出（刚搬来还不clear，但going up）："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "租金：3000", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "托儿：2500", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "杂货和外出就餐：1000-2000", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "九、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Snow认为多年来budgeting不够strict。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在韩国时accumulated约30万美元debt。但搬来美国前，liquidated some family investments pay most off。Now only owe约5万。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Committed focusing on budgeting、keeping expenses down、keeping financial models up to date in Google Sheets。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That said，love travel world with son。在韩国时，每年海外旅行两次，花约1.5万/年travel。Hope continue that，即使搬到更expensive地方。Non-negotiable。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""I travel with family a lot。That time spent with family cannot be purchased after son grows up。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "十、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Snow妻子管理investments。While he'd like have hand in it，cannot fully invest time into both business和personal finances，so focus on former。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Time是最expensive resource。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "妻子60%投stock market，5% miscellaneous investments。Rest进"safe haven" fund——savings account for rainy days和emergencies。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最近自己做了一个investment——splurged on Tesla。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "4.5万美元cash paid。不是really necessary，但love the car、enjoys driving it。Usually don't like driving，所以也许是investment in enjoying time on road。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But cars不是good assets，he knows it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Invest in assets；not liabilities。Already regret purchased Tesla。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Snow的故事是关于reinvention——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Two exits in Korea。Debt。Move to US。Start over。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "His philosophy？"}, {"insert": "Business is the only way to become rich from scratch。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Key insights——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Building in public brings investors", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Network is everything", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Fund to validate，not to scale prematurely", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Time with family > Money", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Invest in assets，not liabilities（regrets Tesla）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最重要的是，"}, {"insert": "he's willing to start over at 38。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " New country。New network。New challenges。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That's entrepreneurial spirit。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: After two exits at 38 he says entrepreneurship is only way to get rich. Took 660k pre-seed he moved to Silicon Valley to start over. Snow Lee exited two businesses while in Korea. Last month moved entire family to California to work on latest project PlugBear. Business has 470k in bank received angel investors cash injection. Currently monthly revenue 7200 dollars. Until the moment he started his first company after graduating from university did Snow first think about money. Growing up family was not struggling. Not rich but table had food so did not need think about it. But now wants to be rich. Started dreaming about future realized needed money even to focus on that dream. Although do not think money is most important thing in world believes it is mandatory element of getting to next level.
content_jp: 38歳で2回のexit 후、 entrepreneurshipは唯一の富の方法이라고他说.660kのpre-seedを取りSilicon Valleyへ搬去重新开始. Snow Leeは韓国で2つのビジネスをexit.先月、家族全体をCaliforniaに搬して最新のプロジェクトPlugBearに取り組む.ビジネスには470kの銀行があり、angel investorsから現金注入を受けた.現在の月間収益は7200ドル. Snowが大学毕业后第一个公司を始めるまで、彼は一切돈에 대해 생각한ことがなかった.育ち상은 Struggleしてなかった.裕福ではなかったが食卓に食べ物があった，所以不需要想它.でも今、富になりたい.将来の夢を始め、お金を必要とすることに気づいた.富さが世界で最も重要だとは思いません.nextレベルに行くための必須要素だと信じています.
content_ar: بعد عمليتين خروج في 38 يقول إن ريادة الأعمال هي الطريقة الوحيدة للت RICH. أخذ 660k pre-seed انتقل إلى وادي السيليكون للبدء من جديد. Snow Lee خرج من شركتين بينما كان في Korea. الشهر الماضي نقل العائلة بأكملها إلى California للعمل على أحدث مشروع PlugBear. العمل لديه 470k في البنك حصل على حقن نقدي من المستثمرين الملائكة. حالياً الإيرادات الشهرية 7200 دولار. حتى اللحظة التي بدأ فيها شركته الأولى بعد التخرج من الجامعة فكر Snow впервые في المال. خلال نشأتي كانت العائلة لا تكافح. ليست غنية لكن على الطاولة كان هناك طعام поэтому لا تحتاج للتفكير في ذلك. لكنه الآن يريد أن يكون غنياً. بدأ يحلم بالمستقبل أدرك أنه يحتاج إلى المال حتى يركز على هذا الحلم. على الرغم من أنني لا أعتقد أن المال أهم شيء في العالم إلا أنه عنصر إلزامي للوصول إلى المستوى التالي.
